title: 有些城市为什么向游客收税
title_en: Why Some Cities Charge Visitors a Tourist Tax
summary_zh: 住酒店时，账单上多了一笔「游客税」。越来越多的热门城市这样做：钱用来打扫街道、维护景点，也想让游客错开高峰。读完你能看懂这类新闻，并用 so that 和 while 说出两方的看法。
body: When you check out of a hotel in many popular cities, you may notice an extra charge on your bill. It is often called a tourist tax, and it is usually a small amount for each night of your stay. More and more places now do this, and the reasons are easy to understand. Popular cities spend a lot of money on cleaning streets, collecting rubbish and looking after historic buildings. Residents pay for these services through their own taxes, but visitors use them too. A tourist tax is a way to make sure that visitors share some of the cost. Some towns also charge more in the busiest months so that people will think about visiting at quieter times. Not everyone agrees with the idea. Hotel owners sometimes worry that extra charges will send visitors to cheaper places nearby. Some travellers say they already spend plenty in shops and restaurants. However, the amount is usually small compared with the price of the room. While a few euros a night will not change most people's plans, it can add up to a lot of money for a city. If the money really goes back into the places that visitors love, many travellers are happy to pay it.

options: How to find a cheap hotel
Why some cities charge visitors a small tax
Why tourists should stay at home

questions.prompt: Why might a town charge more in the busiest months?
options: To encourage people to visit at quieter times
Because hotels are closed in winter
questions.evidence: so that people will think about visiting at quieter times

questions.prompt: What does "add up to" mean in "it can add up to a lot of money"?
questions.evidence: it can add up to a lot of money for a city

questions.prompt: What do some hotel owners worry about?
options: That the tax is too difficult to explain
That visitors will go to cheaper places nearby
questions.evidence: extra charges will send visitors to cheaper places nearby

The city needs better bus services.

More and more people work from home.
Who is looking after your cat?

knowledge.quote: Some towns also charge more in the busiest months so that people will think about visiting at quieter times.
knowledge.explanation: so that 引导目的状语从句，说明“为了让人们考虑淡季来”。

knowledge.quote: While a few euros a night will not change most people's plans, it can add up to a lot of money for a city.
knowledge.explanation: While 在这里表示对比（虽然……但是……），前后两句意思相对。

knowledge.quote: If the money really goes back into the places that visitors love, many travellers are happy to pay it.
knowledge.explanation: 真实条件句：if 从句用一般现在时，主句说一般情况下的结果。

speaking: 用 1 分钟说说：你愿意出门旅行时多交一点「游客税」吗？为什么？用上 so that 和 compared with。
writing: 用 80–100 词写一段话，说说游客税的一个好处和一个问题，最后给出你的看法。用一个 While… 对比句。

task.prompt: 仿照这句，用 … is a way to make sure that … 写一句话，说明一个规定的作用。
task.model: A tourist tax is a way to make sure that visitors share some of the cost.

title: 出发前写给寄宿家庭的信
title_en: An Email to My Host Family Before I Arrive
summary_zh: 下个月要去寄宿家庭住三周，Lin 先写了一封邮件：介绍自己、说明到达时间、提到饮食习惯，再问几个实际问题。读完你能写一封自然又礼貌的自我介绍邮件。
body: Dear Mr and Mrs Carter, my name is Lin Yue, and I am going to stay with you for three weeks next month while I take an English course in your town. I wanted to write before I arrive so that you know a little about me. I am nineteen and I study engineering at university in Chengdu. In my free time I like cooking, playing badminton and taking photos of old buildings. My flight lands at a quarter past four on Saturday the twelfth, and the school has told me that a driver will bring me to your house. I should arrive at about six, but I will send you a message if the flight is late. I eat almost everything, although I do not drink milk because it makes me feel ill. I hope that is not a problem. I also have a few questions. Is there anything I should bring for the house, such as a towel? Is it all right if I use the kitchen to cook a Chinese meal for you one evening? I would love to share some food from my home town. Thank you very much for having me, and I am looking forward to meeting you both. Best wishes, Lin Yue

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of Lin's email?
options: To introduce herself and ask some questions before she arrives
To ask the family to pick her up
questions.evidence: I wanted to write before I arrive so that you know a little about me.

questions.prompt: Why does Lin offer to cook a Chinese meal?
options: She does not like English food
She wants to share something from her home and be friendly
The family asked her to cook
questions.evidence: I would love to share some food from my home town.

questions.prompt: What does "having me" mean in "Thank you very much for having me"?
options: letting me stay as your guest
questions.evidence: Thank you very much for having me

questions.prompt: Who will take Lin from the airport to the house?
options: A driver arranged by the school
questions.evidence: the school has told me that a driver will bring me to your house

vocabulary.example: I felt ill after the long journey.
Don't forget to pack a towel.

expressions.note: I stayed with my aunt for a week.
自我介绍里介绍爱好时常用。
英式说时间：half past, a quarter to…
比 Can I…? 更客气的请求。
Thank you for having me 是做客后的常用感谢。
后面接名词或 -ing：I'm looking forward to seeing you.

knowledge.quote: I wanted to write before I arrive so that you know a little about me.
knowledge.explanation: so that 引导目的状语从句，说明写信的目的。

knowledge.quote: I eat almost everything, although I do not drink milk because it makes me feel ill.
knowledge.explanation: although 引出让步，because 说明原因：一句话里先说大部分都吃，再说一个例外和原因。

knowledge.quote: I will send you a message if the flight is late
knowledge.explanation: 真实条件句：if 从句用一般现在时 is，主句用 will send。

speaking: 用 1 分钟练习：第一次见寄宿家庭或新室友，介绍自己、你的爱好和一个生活习惯。用上 in my free time 和 Is it all right if…?
writing: 用 80–100 词写一封邮件给你要去住的人家（或新室友），介绍自己、说明到达时间，并问两个问题。用一个 so that 句子。

task.prompt: 仿照这句，用 Is it all right if I …? 写一个礼貌的请求。
task.model: Is it all right if I use the kitchen to cook a Chinese meal for you one evening?
